units.source_text: 这位老夫人并非十分富有情趣的人，但人多称她为爱好时髦而饶有才华的更衣。

en.t: This elderly lady was not especially refined in taste, but many people called her a fashionable and talented lady-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 夕雾见她迅速答诗，觉得果然是个伶俐乖巧的人。

en.t: When Yugiri saw how quickly she answered with a poem, he thought she was indeed clever and quick-witted.
